name: reverse-grip-dumbbell-squeeze-press
instructions:
1. Pick up the dumbbells off the floor using a neutral grip (palms facing in). Position the ends of the dumbbells in your hip crease, and sit down on the bench.
2. To get into position, lay back and keep the weights close to your chest. Once you are in position, take a deep breath, then press the dumbbells to lockout at the top.
3. Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest while rotating the handles to a supinated position. Try to maintain contact between the bottom of the dumbbells throughout the entire range of motion.
4. When pressing the dumbbells back to the starting position, rotate the handles back to a neutral position while pressing the bottom of the dumbbells together.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
